title: 高老庄遇八戒
subtitle: 放下点心来帮忙
origin: 《西游记》第十八至十九回（低龄改编）

moral.zh: 真正的热心不只在嘴上；把答应的事做完，才能让大家信赖。
moral.en: A warm heart matters most when we follow through and finish what we promised.

pages.zh: 师徒来到高老庄，只见大木梁横在水渠上，磨坊也停了下来。
pages.en: The travelers reached Gao Village and found a heavy beam across the water channel. The mill had stopped turning.
